brief.topic: Al-Baqarah 2:45-46: seek help through patience and prayer
brief.audience: Muslims who want a short, trustworthy daily reminder they can act on

coreInsight: Al-Baqarah 2:45 tells us to seek help through patience and prayer, so when the day is heavy, salah is where to turn first.

hooks.notes: Makes the viewer check their own habit.

hooks.text: Stressed? Read this before you reach for your phone.
hooks.notes: Too long for the first frame.

hooks.text: Help is closer than you think

selectionRationale: Most relevant and clearest at a glance; the teaching pays it off.

scenes.onScreen: When it gets heavy, where do you turn first? / This ayah answers.

scenes.purpose: Teaching: the source, verbatim, with its reference.

scenes.onScreen: REFLECTION / Turn to salah first. / This ayah names two sources of help: patience and prayer. It also admits it isn't easy. Before the next scroll or rant, try two rak'ah and a few quiet minutes with Allah.
body: This ayah names two sources of help: patience and prayer. It also admits it isn't easy.
Before the next scroll or rant, try two rak'ah and a few quiet minutes with Allah.

caption.opening: When the day gets heavy, where do you turn first?
body: Al-Baqarah 2:45-46: seek help through patience and prayer, and it is difficult except for the humbly submissive.
Next time: two rak'ah and a few quiet minutes with Allah, before anything else.
caption.cta: Share it with someone who may find it helpful.

claims.text: Turning to salah before anything else on a heavy day is our reflection on the ayat.
